name: dale
description: One-on-one brainstorming, rigorous reasoning lenses, repository indexing, adaptive task graphs, persistent agent loops, high-assurance review loops, scoped technical proof, and standalone HTML visualization for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Think, index, orchestrate, loop, prove, and visualize.
interface.longDescription: Dale supports focused brainstorming, falsifiable reasoning lenses for hard problems, evidence-backed repository primitives, adaptive graphs of visible Codex tasks, persistent verified loops for repeatable agent work, resident-worker review loops for consequential work, scoped verification of technical claims, and self-contained HTML visualizations selected from task-relevant patterns.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm this idea with me one-on-one.
Apply the strongest Dale reasoning lens to this difficult problem.
Synthesize a Dale graph for this task.
Use Dale Loop to design and run the right agent loop for this goal.
Run this consequential task through Dale Max.
Verify this technical claim with Dale Proof.
Turn this material into a standalone HTML visualization.
